plugins.name: seo-aeo-geo-ultimate
plugins.description: An autonomous SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI-search router that screens 27 evidence-first skills, executes every applicable specialist workflow, and returns one consolidated result.

skills.name: ai-search-research
skills.description: Use when a request concerns AEO/GEO demand research, AI-answer or generative-search query-corpus research, entity or source-landscape mapping, citation-source or competitor benchmarking, bilingual TR/EN research, missing-access planning, evidence freshness or classification, or pressure to treat unproven tactics as universal rules; do not use for page audits, content rewriting, technical SEO, schema, hreflang, implementation, or longitudinal visibility monitoring.
skills.description_zh: 研究 AEO/GEO 需求、AI 回答及生成式搜索查询语料、实体与来源分布、引用来源及竞品基准，支持土耳其语与英语双语研究、访问缺口规划、证据时效和分类，并处理将未证实技巧当通则的倾向；不用于页面审查、改写、技术 SEO、结构化数据、hreflang、实施或长期可见度监测。

skills.name: ai-visibility-monitor
skills.description: Measure repeatable AI-search mention, citation, answer accuracy, cited-source share, referral, retrieval traces, citation-to-claim support, uncertainty, and non-causal drift from a frozen, hash-pinned Query Corpus and contract-valid Research Pack. Use for AI visibility baselines, repeated engine/surface observations, citation monitoring, grounding-query or consulted-source capture when disclosed, access-gap reporting, or comparison runs. Do not use for live research, query discovery, optimization, access-control bypass, rankings, guarantees, or causal attribution.
skills.description_zh: 基于冻结且以哈希固定的查询语料及符合约定的 Research Pack，重复测量 AI 搜索提及、引用、回答准确度、引用来源占比、引荐、检索轨迹、引用对主张的支持、不确定性和非因果变化。适用于基线、重复观察、访问缺口及对比；不做实时研究、发现查询、优化、绕过访问控制、排名承诺或因果归因。

skills.name: optimise-seo
skills.description: Use when explicitly authorized to implement a bounded, approved SEO action in a codebase or content system, verify the exact change, and report its limitations; do not use for broad audits, self-approved production changes, or outcome guarantees.
skills.description_zh: 在明确授权下，于代码库或内容系统实施范围确定且已批准的 SEO 动作，核验具体修改并报告局限；不用于广泛审查、自行批准生产变更或保证效果。

skills.name: seo-action-plan
skills.description: Use when turning validated SEO, AEO, GEO, technical, or measurement findings into an approval-ready, evidence-linked action plan without claiming guaranteed ranking, citation, traffic, or conversion outcomes.
skills.description_zh: 将已验证的 SEO、AEO、GEO、技术或测量发现整理为带证据关联、可供批准的行动计划，不保证排名、引用、流量或转化结果。

skills.name: seo-aeo
skills.description: Audit supplied pages, documents, or content sets for direct-answer completeness, question and intent coverage, clarity, extractability, claim support, and visible-content consistency against a pinned AI-search Research Pack. Use for AEO, answer-engine optimization, answer readiness, answer extraction, featured-answer preparation, or requests asking whether content clearly and supportably answers researched questions. Do not use for generative-engine mention/citation strategy, live research, content rewriting, schema generation, technical SEO implementation, or visibility monitoring.
skills.description_zh: 依据固定的 AI 搜索 Research Pack，审查所提供页面、文档或内容集合的直接回答完整性、问题及意图覆盖、清晰度、可提取性、主张证据和可见内容一致性。适用于 AEO 和回答准备度；不负责生成式引擎提及策略、实时研究、改写、结构化数据、技术实施或可见度监测。

skills.name: seo-agentic
skills.description: Use when auditing whether an AI agent can safely understand and complete a web task through the rendered interface, DOM, accessibility tree, forms, authentication, consent, state changes, and documented protocol capabilities such as UCP, ACP, MCP, or A2A; treat this as task readiness and accessibility, not a ranking factor or guaranteed agent usage.
skills.description_zh: 审查 AI 智能体能否通过渲染界面、DOM、无障碍树、表单、认证、同意及状态变化安全理解并完成网页任务，并核对 UCP、ACP、MCP、A2A 等已记录协议能力。评估任务准备度与可访问性，不将其视为排名因素或保证智能体使用。

skills.name: seo-architecture
skills.description: Use when auditing or designing site architecture, internal-link graphs, crawl depth, orphan pages, hubs, navigation, contextual anchors, pagination, facets, taxonomy, template links, or URL-to-query coverage at scale; require a bounded captured graph and business/user rationale rather than arbitrary click-depth, link-count, or PageRank-like score targets.
skills.description_zh: 审查或设计大规模网站架构、内部链接图、抓取深度、孤立页面、中心页、导航、上下文锚点、分页、筛选面、分类、模板链接和 URL 对查询覆盖。要求有界的已采集链接图及业务和用户依据，不采用任意点击深度、链接数量或类似 PageRank 分数作为目标。

skills.name: seo-audit
skills.description: Use when a site needs a bounded multi-lane SEO assessment with explicit scope, evidence capture, findings, ownership, and limitations; coordinate specialists rather than produce a universal audit score or unverified implementation claim.
skills.description_zh: 统筹范围明确的多方向 SEO 评估，明确范围、证据采集、发现、责任人和局限，并协调专项审查；不生成通用总分或声称完成未经验证的实施。

skills.name: seo-authority
skills.description: Use when auditing backlinks, referring domains, source citations, brand mentions, unlinked mentions, linkable assets, digital PR evidence, or off-site source landscapes from authorized first-party, Bing, vendor, or public evidence; preserve vendor metric definitions, detect manipulative risk, and never treat a proprietary authority score as universal truth or recommend link schemes.
skills.description_zh: 依据授权的一方、Bing、供应商或公开证据，审查反向链接、引荐域、来源引用、品牌提及、未链接提及、可获链接内容资产、数字公关及站外来源分布。保留供应商指标定义并识别操纵风险，不把专有权威分数当普遍真理或推荐链接作弊。

skills.name: seo-commerce
skills.description: Use when auditing or planning ecommerce search visibility across product/category pages, Product or MerchantListing structured data, Google Merchant Center, Bing shopping feeds, price/availability/shipping/returns parity, IndexNow freshness, or documented AI product-discovery and commerce integrations; require visible-page and feed truth, policy evidence, and no eligibility, ranking, recommendation, or sales guarantee.
skills.description_zh: 审查或规划电商搜索可见度，覆盖商品和分类页、Product/MerchantListing 结构化数据、Google Merchant Center、Bing 商品数据源、价格库存及配送退货一致性、IndexNow 时效和已记录的 AI 商品发现与商业集成。要求页面、数据源和政策证据真实，不保证资格、排名、推荐或销售。

skills.name: seo-competitor-pages
skills.description: Use when researching, briefing, or drafting fair comparison, versus, or alternative pages using dated, attributable product evidence; avoid unsupported superiority claims, copied competitor content, and artificial SEO comparisons.
skills.description_zh: 依据注明日期且可归属的产品证据，研究、拟定或撰写公允的产品对比、竞品比较和替代方案页面；避免无依据的优越性主张、复制竞品内容或人为制造 SEO 对比。

skills.name: seo-content
skills.description: Use when auditing, briefing, rewriting, or reviewing site content for a defined audience, page purpose, locale, and evidence set; produce human-reviewable content improvements without formulaic SEO or AI-citation guarantees.
skills.description_zh: 针对明确受众、页面目的、地区语言和证据集合，审查、拟定、改写或复核网站内容，产出可由人工评审的改进；不采用公式化 SEO 或保证 AI 引用。

skills.name: seo-geo
skills.description: Audit supplied pages, entity records, source captures, and citation observations for generative-engine entity consistency, evidence traceability, citation suitability, cited-source alignment, and documented engine controls against a pinned AI-search Research Pack. Use for GEO, generative-engine optimization, AI citations, brand or entity mentions in generative answers, source alignment, or documented AI-search control audits. Do not use for direct-answer formatting or extractability, live research, content rewriting, schema generation, technical SEO implementation, longitudinal visibility measurement, or guaranteed placement claims.
skills.description_zh: 依据固定的 AI 搜索 Research Pack，审查页面、实体记录、来源采集和引用观察中的实体一致性、证据可追溯性、引用适用性、引用来源对齐及已记录引擎控制。适用于 GEO、AI 引用和生成式回答中的品牌提及；不负责直接回答格式、实时研究、改写、结构化数据、技术实施、长期测量或保证展示。

skills.name: seo-hreflang
skills.description: Use when auditing or planning language-region targeting, hreflang clusters, localized URL mappings, canonical alignment, or x-default behavior from an explicit locale and URL inventory; provide safe implementation guidance without inventing translations or markets.
skills.description_zh: 依据明确的地区语言和 URL 清单，审查或规划语言地区定位、hreflang 组、本地化 URL 映射、canonical 对齐及 x-default 行为，提供安全的实施指导；不编造翻译或目标市场。

skills.name: seo-images
skills.description: Use when reviewing image accessibility, discoverability, metadata, responsive delivery, image sitemaps, or visual performance from a page/media inventory; provide evidence-linked improvements without keyword, format, or ranking guarantees.
skills.description_zh: 依据页面及媒体清单，审查图片可访问性、可发现性、元数据、响应式交付、图片站点地图和视觉性能，提供关联证据的改进；不保证关键词、格式或排名效果。

skills.name: seo-local
skills.description: Use when auditing or planning local search visibility for a storefront, service-area business, practitioner, or multi-location brand across Google Business Profile, Bing Places, NAP/hours/categories, location pages, LocalBusiness data, reviews, duplicates, service areas, and location-aware query evidence; require authorized profile data and never promise map rankings, calls, visits, or revenue.
skills.description_zh: 审查或规划门店、服务区域商家、执业者及多地点品牌的本地搜索可见度，涵盖 Google Business Profile、Bing Places、名称地址电话、营业时间、类别、地点页、LocalBusiness 数据、评论、重复项、服务区域及地域查询证据。要求授权的商家资料，不保证地图排名、来电、到访或收入。

skills.name: seo-news-discover
skills.description: Use when auditing or planning publisher visibility for Google News, Discover, news search, or comparable freshness-sensitive surfaces across editorial policy, article pages, dates/bylines, corrections, large images, NewsArticle markup, news sitemaps, feeds, paywalls, and first-party reports; require current policy evidence and never promise inclusion, Top stories, Discover traffic, subscriptions, or revenue.
skills.description_zh: 审查或规划出版方在 Google News、Discover、新闻搜索及其他时效敏感渠道的可见度，覆盖编辑政策、文章页、日期署名、更正、大图、NewsArticle、新闻站点地图、数据源、付费墙和一方报告。要求当前政策证据，不保证收录、热门报道、流量、订阅或收入。

skills.name: seo-page
skills.description: Use when one URL needs a bounded mixed SEO review across reader task, content, metadata, links, technical delivery, accessibility, and structured data; produce an evidence map and route each fix to its real owner instead of a page score.
skills.description_zh: 对单个 URL 开展范围明确的综合 SEO 复核，涵盖读者任务、内容、元数据、链接、技术交付、无障碍和结构化数据，形成证据映射并把修复分配给实际责任人，不给页面打总分。

skills.name: seo-performance
skills.description: Use when establishing or comparing conventional SEO performance from authorized Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, analytics, server-log, indexation, or Core Web Vitals/RUM evidence, or when designing and evaluating a controlled SEO experiment; preserve dimensions and data-quality limits, keep metric families separate, and never turn observational movement into a causal or composite SEO score.
skills.description_zh: 依据授权的 Google Search Console、Bing Webmaster Tools、分析、服务器日志、索引或 Core Web Vitals/RUM 数据建立并对比常规 SEO 表现，或设计评估受控实验。保留维度和数据质量限制，分开指标类别，不把观察变化转成因果结论或综合 SEO 分数。

skills.name: seo-plan
skills.description: Use when sequencing validated SEO findings and approved action-plan items into an owner-based roadmap with dependencies, review gates, measurable outcomes, and risk controls; do not use it to invent work, fixed uplift forecasts, or a one-size-fits-all calendar.
skills.description_zh: 将已验证的 SEO 发现和获批行动项排入由责任人负责的路线图，标明依赖、复核关卡、可测量结果和风险控制；不凭空增加工作、给出固定增长预测或通用日历。

skills.name: seo-programmatic
skills.description: Use when designing, auditing, or improving scaled/template-driven SEO pages, data-backed landing-page systems, or large URL inventories; require source data, usefulness, variation, indexing controls, and rollout safeguards rather than scale or keyword coverage targets.
skills.description_zh: 设计、审查或改进批量及模板驱动的 SEO 页面、数据支持的落地页系统和大型 URL 清单，要求源数据、有用性、差异性、索引控制和上线保护，而非单纯追求规模或关键词覆盖。

skills.name: seo-research
skills.description: Use when researching conventional search intent, audience questions, query families, content gaps, site coverage, cannibalization, or competitor/page evidence for a bounded SEO decision; produce a provenance-aware query corpus when the work will drive measurement or implementation, retain source dates and uncertainty, and route formal multi-engine AI-search evidence to ai-search-research.
skills.description_zh: 为范围明确的 SEO 决策研究常规搜索意图、受众问题、查询类别、内容缺口、网站覆盖、关键词内耗及竞品页面证据。后续用于测量或实施时生成可追溯查询语料，保留来源日期和不确定性；正式的多引擎 AI 搜索证据研究转交 ai-search-research。

skills.name: seo-schema
skills.description: Use when detecting, validating, planning, or generating truthful Schema.org markup tied to visible page content and current search-feature documentation; do not use it to promise rich results, AI citations, or rankings.
skills.description_zh: 检测、校验、规划或生成与可见页面内容及当前搜索功能文档相符的真实 Schema.org 标记；不保证富媒体搜索结果、AI 引用或排名。

skills.name: seo-sitemap
skills.description: Use when auditing, generating, or planning XML sitemap changes from a verified canonical URL inventory, discovery evidence, and current protocol guidance; do not promise crawling or indexing from sitemap inclusion.
skills.description_zh: 依据已验证的规范 URL 清单、发现证据及当前协议指导，审查、生成或规划 XML 站点地图变更；不因加入站点地图而保证抓取或索引。

skills.name: seo-technical
skills.description: Use when investigating crawlability, indexability, canonicalization, rendering, performance, redirects, directives, sitemaps, crawler controls, site migrations, sudden traffic/index incidents, manual actions, hacked-site recovery, or when evaluating, generating, validating, publishing, and maintaining an evidence-scoped llms.txt publisher guide; return safe, testable implementation recommendations rather than a generic technical score.
skills.description_zh: 调查抓取、索引、canonical、渲染、性能、重定向、指令、站点地图、爬虫控制、迁站、流量或索引突发异常、人工处罚及被入侵网站恢复，也可按证据范围评估、生成、验证、发布和维护 llms.txt 出版方指南；给出安全且可测试的实施建议，不提供通用技术总分。

skills.name: seo-video
skills.description: Use when auditing or planning video discovery and indexing across watch pages, embedded players, thumbnails, VideoObject markup, video sitemaps, transcripts, captions, Key Moments, livestreams, locale variants, and first-party video indexing reports; require captured player/page evidence and never promise video indexing, rich results, views, citations, or watch time.
skills.description_zh: 审查或规划视频发现与索引，涵盖观看页、嵌入播放器、缩略图、VideoObject、视频站点地图、转录、字幕、关键时刻、直播、地区语言版本及一方视频索引报告。要求已采集的播放器和页面证据，不保证索引、富媒体结果、观看量、引用或观看时长。

skills.name: seo
skills.description: The autonomous front door and end-to-end orchestrator for any SEO, AEO, GEO, or AI-search request. Translate ordinary user goals into a complete 27-skill coverage screen, execute every applicable specialist workflow, carry evidence and handoffs internally, and return one consolidated result to the authorized boundary; direct specialist invocation remains optional. Do not create a universal score, unsupported control, causal uplift claim, or placement guarantee.
skills.description_zh: 作为 SEO、AEO、GEO 和 AI 搜索请求的统一入口，将普通用户目标映射到完整的 27 项技能覆盖检查，执行适用专项流程并在内部传递证据和交接，向授权边界交付综合结果。可直接调用专项技能；不创建通用分数、无依据控制、因果增长主张或展示保证。
